mechanism: Diltiazem inhibits CYP3A4 and may increase valproic acid levels; valproic acid may displace diltiazem from protein binding and inhibit its metabolism.
action: Monitor valproic acid and diltiazem levels; assess for increased valproic acid toxicity (tremor, sedation, ataxia) and diltiazem effects (bradycardia, hypotension); consider dose adjustment if needed.
